enriched_description: Medium-sized Swiss breed with a short, glossy, tricolor coat of black with tan and white markings. Coat is smooth, dense, and close-lying with a distinctive white blaze on the face, white chest, and white tail tip. Body is compact, well-muscled, and slightly longer than tall with a level topline. Head is broad with a flat skull and strong muzzle. Ears are medium-sized, triangular, pendant, and set high. Tail is tightly curled over the back, a distinctive feature of the breed. Eyes are medium-sized, almond-shaped, and dark with an alert, intelligent expression. The breed's signature features include its tricolor pattern and tightly curled tail.

Smallest of the four Swiss Sennenhunde breeds with a short, dense, tricolor coat of black with tan and white markings. Coat is smooth, glossy, and close-lying with white markings on the face, chest, legs, and tail tip. Body is compact, well-muscled, and slightly longer than tall with a level topline. Head is broad with a flat skull and strong muzzle. Ears are small, triangular, pendant, and set high. Tail is naturally short or docked. Eyes are medium-sized, almond-shaped, and dark brown with an alert, cheerful expression. The breed's signature features include its compact size, tricolor pattern, and cheerful demeanor.

Medium-large, stocky dog with a short, smooth, glossy coat in fawn or brindle with white markings. Coat is fine, tight-fitting, and shiny. Body is muscular, square-proportioned, and substantial with a broad chest and powerful hindquarters. Head is distinctive with a broad, blunt muzzle and undershot jaw. Ears are set high, traditionally cropped to erect points, or natural and pendant. Tail is docked short. Eyes are dark brown, large, and expressive with an alert, intelligent expression. The breed's signature features include its square-jawed muzzle, muscular build, and distinctive fawn or brindle coat.

Large, powerful breed with a short, dense coat in red, fawn, or brindle with a distinctive black mask on the face. Coat is smooth, hard, and lies close to the body. Body is massive, well-muscled, and slightly longer than tall with a broad, deep chest. Head is broad and square with a short, wide muzzle and wrinkled forehead. Ears are V-shaped, pendant, set wide and high. Tail is straight or curved, set high, and carried level. Eyes are medium-sized, dark, and set wide apart with an alert, intelligent expression. The breed's signature features include its massive build, black mask, and powerful, imposing presence.

Very large, powerful dog with a thick, rough, double coat in black, black-and-tan, various shades of gold, or blue-grey. Coat is coarse, dense, and abundant with a heavy mane around the neck, especially pronounced in males. Body is massive, well-muscled, and slightly longer than tall with a broad chest. Head is broad and heavy with a strong muzzle. Ears are medium-sized, pendant, triangular, and set high. Tail is long, bushy, and carried curled over the back. Eyes are medium-sized, almond-shaped, and dark with an alert, dignified expression. The breed's signature features include its massive size, thick coat with mane, and imposing, lion-like appearance.

Small, stocky bulldog with a short, smooth, sleek coat in brindle, fawn, white, or combinations. Coat is fine, soft, and glossy. Body is compact, muscular, and heavy-boned with a broad chest and distinctive bat-like ears. Head is large and square with a short, broad muzzle and wrinkled face. Ears are large, erect, broad at the base, rounded at the top (bat ears). Tail is short, straight or screwed. Eyes are medium-sized, round, dark, and set wide apart with an alert, intelligent expression. The breed's signature features include its bat ears, compact build, and distinctive pushed-in face.

Very large, powerful dog with a short, smooth, glossy coat in fawn, brindle, blue, black, harlequin, or mantle. Coat is fine, dense, and lies close to the body. Body is tall, muscular, and well-proportioned with a deep chest and level topline. Head is long, rectangular, and expressive with a flat skull and strong muzzle. Ears are set high, traditionally cropped to erect points, or natural and pendant. Tail is long, thick at the base, and tapers to a point. Eyes are medium-sized, deep-set, and dark with an intelligent, alert expression. The breed's signature features include its towering height, elegant build, and distinctive coat colors.

Very large, powerful Swiss alpine dog with a thick, dense coat in red-and-white or mahogany-brindle-and-white. Coat comes in smooth (short) or rough (long) varieties, both with a dense undercoat. Body is massive, well-muscled, and slightly longer than tall with a broad chest. Head is broad and powerful with a short muzzle and wrinkled forehead. Ears are medium-sized, pendant, and set high. Tail is long, bushy, and carried low with a slight upward curve. Eyes are medium-sized, dark brown, and set deep with a gentle, intelligent expression. The breed's signature features include its massive size, thick coat, and gentle, rescue-dog heritage.

Heavy-coated Arctic sled dog with a thick, dense double coat in various colors including white, black, red, and combinations. Coat is coarse, straight, and abundant with a soft, thick undercoat. Body is powerful, well-muscled, and slightly longer than tall with a broad chest. Head is broad with a large skull and strong muzzle. Ears are small, triangular, erect, and set wide apart. Tail is bushy and carried over the back in a sickle or curved shape. Eyes are medium-sized, almond-shaped, and brown with an alert, intelligent expression. The breed's signature features include its thick Arctic coat, powerful build, and curled tail.

Large, powerful sled dog with a thick, coarse double coat in grey-and-white, black-and-white, red-and-white, or solid white. Coat is dense with a soft, woolly undercoat and coarse outer guard hairs. Body is heavy-boned, well-muscled, and slightly longer than tall with a broad chest. Head is broad with a large skull and strong muzzle. Ears are medium-sized, triangular, erect, and set wide apart. Tail is well-plumed and carried over the back in a waving sickle position. Eyes are medium-sized, almond-shaped, and brown with a soft, friendly expression. The breed's signature features include its massive size, thick coat, and distinctive plumed tail carried over the back.
